title: Jaws Toy Hunt
prompt: A game where you enter a huge store through the jaws of a giant shark and you have to run through the halls to find the coolest toys. There's an arcade machine where you can run up and push a button and it will make a fart noise. There's an area in the center of the store with a giant vat of water that has smaller sharks in it and you can stick your hands in to get the shark's attention, but you have to watch out for the store owner, who patrols the store looking for kids who put their hands in the water.
controls_label: 🕹️ thumb stick + JUMP + GRAB · ⌨️ arrows/WASD + Space + X

look.name: Big Blue Boardwalk

judge.reason: Candidate 2 and image 1 look like the same toy-store game. Both show toy shelves and boxes, and a small kid character. Both use the same '← ARCADE' back link with a bold cartoon font and rounded round action buttons (DASH in 1, GRAB and JUMP
